messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "seek medical attention if breathing problems get worse quickly"
set: ["seek medical attention if breathing problems get worse quickly", "seek emergency medical attention", "caregiver should seek emergency medical attention", "seek attention if you have slow breathing with long pauses", "get emergency medical help if you have difficulty breathing", "seek emergency medical attention for coughing up blood", "call doctor if symptoms get worse", "seek emergency medical attention for blood in urine", "seek medical attention if asthma medications are not working as well", "seek medical attention if you think your medications are not working", "seek emergency medical attention for black or bloody stools", "seek attention if you have blue-colored lips", "get medical help", "seek medical attention right away if you have symptoms of serotonin syndrome", "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if bleeding will not stop", "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if fall or hit head"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
